Ammonium Aceticum.



Ammonia acetate. Spiritus Mindereri. C 2  H 3  O 2  NH 4.  Aqueous solution.



Clinical. ─   Diabetes. Fever. Sweat.



Characteristics. ─   This is a very old medicine in
        great use in old-school practice for "fever mixtures." It has been experimented
        with by Wibmer, who experienced the following symptoms: "Scraping in throat. Increased
        warmth in abdomen; in the skin, especially of face. Heaviness in the head." It causes
        profuse flow of urine, said to contain sugar. "Bathed in sweat" is a leading
        indication.
